utterance: The existing VPC `analytics-vpc` (10.60.0.0/16) runs the analytics workload on dedicated tenancy and today has no way out at all. Make sure it resolves DNS and hands out DNS hostnames, attach an internet gateway to it, and give its outward-facing segment `analytics-edge-a` internet access: a route table in that VPC that carries the segment and whose default route (0.0.0.0/0) leaves through that gateway. Give every resource you create a Name tag that identifies it.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: analytics-vpc resolves DNS and hands out DNS hostnames, and its segment analytics-edge-a is carried by a route table of that VPC whose 0.0.0.0/0 route leaves through an internet gateway that is attached to it — the gateway the account already keeps for that purpose when it keeps one — with a Name tag on both that table and that gateway; that table is the one the account already keeps that network's outward routing on when it keeps one, and then it is the only table in the network carrying a way out; any other segment of the network that another workload keeps facing outward rides that same table, while a segment held back until it is switched over does not and still carries the marks it is held under
